clue_tomorrow_letter.title: The Tomorrow Letter
clue_tomorrow_letter.description: A heavy cream envelope sealed with purple wax, postmarked tomorrow at 06:00 AM.
clue_tomorrow_letter.lore: Addressed to your name in familiar cursive. It smells faintly of brine and dried lavender.

clue_brass_vault_key.title: The Sea-Salt Brass Key (#7)
clue_brass_vault_key.description: An ornate brass key encrusted with dried salt, bearing the roman numeral VII.
clue_brass_vault_key.lore: Unlocks the seventh drawer in the subterranean archive reading desk.

clue_archivist_log.title: The Archivist's Secret Logbook
clue_archivist_log.description: A ledger tracking memories confiscated from town residents before they could be spoken.
clue_archivist_log.lore: Contains entries dating back thirty years, all marked 'Collected to prevent heartbreak'.

clue_silver_locket.title: The Blank Paper Locket
clue_silver_locket.description: A tarnished silver pendant containing a folded slip of translucent rice paper.
clue_silver_locket.lore: Held close to the lantern flame, faint glowing script appears: 'Do not let tomorrow forget us.'

clue_weather_telegram.title: Meteorological Telegram
clue_weather_telegram.description: Faded telegraph tape warning of temporal tide fluctuations along the southern cliffs.
clue_weather_telegram.lore: Confirms the sea carries discarded memories onto shore whenever high tide hits the lighthouse.
